summary: Add the exact restricted min local-twist theorem for every finite-R root at n=2, mu=2, backed by full physical interface elimination and two independent rational Bernstein replays, while preserving general mu, general n, global min order, and O3a as open.

node.title: Exact full-interface Bernstein closure of the min n=2, mu=2 twist
node.statement: The accepted physical full-relay, sharp internal phase, and relative-continuant claims, together with exact elimination of both momentum matching equations and a rational tensor-Bernstein positivity certificate, imply the restricted min complementary-inertia and local-twist theorem in CLM-NGE2-MPO3A-MIN-N2-MU2-TWIST-R10.

node.title: Restricted min local twist at n=2 and mu=2
node.statement: For every finite R>1 and every arbitrary possibly asymmetric premise-complete transverse common-terminal min-law root with n=2 and mu=2, the scalar dual negative-edge Schur complement H=C P^(-1) C^T-W is strictly positive. Hence the 4-by-4 physical event matrix has inertia (3 positive,1 negative,0 zero), the 3-by-3 relative path matrix satisfies det(L_-)>0, the exact causal functional J is negative, and partial_q A_2<0 in the quotient by the permanent scaling field. No reflection symmetry is assumed. This is conditional on a root in the stated scope and is pointwise local: it asserts neither existence nor fixed-mu global root order, and it does not cover mu!=2, n>2, global min uniqueness, or O3a.

node.title: Extend the n=2 min full-interface sign beyond mu=2
node.statement: For n=2, prove the full positive-negative-positive physical interface scalar H>0 for every mu>1 and finite R>1, or produce an exact or certified premise-complete transverse min root violating the determinant orientation.
node.formal_statement: At every arbitrary possibly asymmetric premise-complete transverse common-terminal min-law root with n=2, finite R>1, and mu>1, use both independent momentum matching equations, common negative energy, strict first-crossing branches, and the sharp positive-negative-positive phase allocation to prove the scalar dual Schur complement H>0. Equivalently establish inertia (3 positive,1 negative,0 zero), det(L_-)>0, J<0, and partial_q A_2<0; or certify a fully physical violating root. The mu=2 slice is already proved and is not the remaining obligation.
discharge_criteria: Cover every mu>1 and finite R>1 for n=2, including arbitrary asymmetric roots; do not infer the result by continuity from the isolated mu=2 slice.
Retain both independent momentum interface equations. The exact gamma-only rational no-go shows that phase thresholds and the combined switch-derivative equation are insufficient.
Keep grazing, collisions, nontransverse roots, and compatible closures separate from the transverse local theorem.
Finite samples or floating-point positivity are non-propagating; a proof must be analytic or exact/certified.
Even a universal n=2 local twist still requires separate fixed-mu global order, norm-residual, and all-n arguments for O3a.

node.title: Full-interface Schur and Bernstein attack on the min branch
node.statement: Split the min event matrix into positive two-by-two cells and negative edges, reduce n=2 to one dual Schur scalar, use the physical time-translation jump to split it into two interface gaps, solve both momentum matches exactly, and certify the resulting mu=2 residual polynomial by rational tensor-Bernstein coefficients. The mu=2,n=2 local theorem is proved; general mu, general n, global min order, and O3a remain open.
node.method_family: Physical event-matrix Schur complementation, exact half-angle momentum elimination, time-reversal interface reciprocity, semialgebraic domain reduction, and exact rational tensor-Bernstein positivity
node.deliverable_contract: A universal min complementary-inertia theorem, an exact or certified physical counterexample, or rigorously audited restricted theorems with the remaining interface and global obligations made explicit.
falsification_tests: Audit the dual Schur inertia direction; n_-(M)=n_+(H), not n_-(H).
Use both independent momentum equations at each material interface; gamma matching alone admits an exact negative scalar no-go.
Apply the local interface theorem separately to actual (x_1,y_2) and time-reversed actual (x_3,y_2), without assuming x_1=x_3 or reflection.
Verify the full rational identity and every tensor Bernstein coefficient over QQ, including strict positivity in the open cube despite zero coefficients.
Do not promote the mu=2 slice, sampled roots, or local twist to general mu, all n, global uniqueness, or O3a.
node.expected_bottleneck: A non-polynomial full-interface inequality for arbitrary mu>1 and, beyond n=2, a positive vector or continuant theorem controlling the off-diagonal dual Jacobi transfer.

rationale.scope: The proposal proves only the pointwise min complementary inertia and q-twist at n=2 and mu=2 for roots already satisfying the complete transverse physical premises. It does not assert existence at mu=2, fixed-mu global order, any result for mu!=2 or n>2, norm-residual uniqueness, min O3a, or universal O3a.
rationale.computation_policy: The Bernstein calculations are exact symbolic arithmetic over QQ and are part of the proof package. Finite floating-point root scans are excluded from every proof step and remain non-propagating discovery evidence.
rationale.audit_policy: The frozen proof package 44da5f1d... and every exact support artifact passed an independent definition, logic, boundary, and adversarial audit bound in 195e5393.... No historical hash or weak gamma-only candidate is submitted as a premise.

ordered_steps: Split the min event matrix into the positive odd-edge block P=D+B_o^T K_o^(-1)B_o>0 and the negative even-edge incidence term. A double Schur complement gives n_-(M)=n_+(H) and n_0(M)=n_0(H) for H=C P^(-1)C^T-W; at n=2, H is the scalar beta_R+beta_L-|K_2|.
Use the exact time-translation jump values on the middle negative cell to define x_*=(gamma_3-gamma_2)/|K_2|>0 and split Hx_* into E_L=beta_R x_*+gamma_2 and E_R=beta_L x_*-gamma_3.
At mu=2 introduce x=tan(theta_positive/2), y=tan(theta_negative/2), and r=sqrt(R). The R8 phase theorem gives r>1 and 0<x<1/sqrt(3)<y<1.

Solve both independent momentum matching equations exactly at a positive-negative interface. The positive and negative amplitude ratios reduce to rational functions with physical denominator signs D_a>0 and N_b>0. Time reversal gives the corresponding right-interface family without equating the actual left and right positive phases.

Substitute the exact interface ratios in E_L and E_R. Both gaps reduce, with fully signed denominators, to the same primitive residual polynomial P(x,y,r), whose expanded rational polynomial has 228 terms, degree (16,12,6), and frozen expanded-string hash 906da324....
Set X=x^2, Y=y^2, and kappa=rx(3Y-1)/(y(1-3X)). The exact N_b decomposition proves 0<kappa<1, and direct cancellation gives P=y^4 Q(X,Y,kappa)/(3Y-1)^2 on the box 0<X<1/3<Y<1.

Map that box to the open unit cube. The exact QQ tensor-Bernstein expansion of Q at degree (10,6,6) has 539 coefficients: 387 positive, 152 zero, and none negative; a full inverse transform and an independent differently oriented reconstruction both pass. Every basis function is positive in the open cube, hence Q>0 and P>0.

Apply the interface lemma separately to the actual left pair (x_1,y_2) and the time-reversed actual right pair (x_3,y_2). They share the same actual middle-cell x_*, so E_L+E_R=Hx_*>0 and H>0 without reflection symmetry.

The scalar H>0 gives In(M)=(3 positive,1 negative,0 zero). Apply the accepted R7 relative-continuant bridge to conclude det(L_-)>0, J<0, and partial_q A_2<0, keeping the theorem pointwise and in the permanent-scaling quotient.
boundary_cases: Covers every finite R>1 but only the exact slice n=2, mu=2 and only premise-complete transverse common-terminal min roots; the theorem is conditional on such a root and does not assert existence.
Arbitrary asymmetric roots are covered. The two actual positive phases may differ, and time reversal is used only as a local interface identity, not as global reflection symmetry.
R=1, mu!=2, n>2, grazing, switch collisions, nontransverse roots, unfinished words, and compatible nongeneric closures remain outside this theorem.

The open phase boundaries x=1/sqrt(3), y=1/sqrt(3), y=1, kappa=0, and kappa=1 are excluded by strict physical energy, phase, and ratio hypotheses. Zero Bernstein coefficients cannot create an interior equality because every basis function is strictly positive there.
The exact gamma-only rational no-go is a failed intermediate lemma, not a physical counterexample. It shows why both momentum equations are essential and is not used to infer the theorem.
All polynomial and Bernstein operations are exact over QQ. Finite root scans and floating-point margins enter no proof step.
A pointwise local q-twist does not imply fixed-mu global root order, norm uniqueness, min O3a, or universal O3a.

math_research_state_records.status_justification: The exact full-interface positivity certificate currently uses the mu=2 tangent double-angle rationalization. No proof for arbitrary mu>1 and no fully physical violating root is known.
The route proves a rigorous n=2, mu=2 local min theorem and exactly refutes a weakened gamma-only proof, while general mu, general n, global min order, and O3a remain open.
